assertions.source: I_T(0), I_T(lam), I_T(2mu) match 1604.02688 Ex 4.1 to q^10

description: GGM 3D-index of the figure-eight 4_1 assembled on the triality-validated tetrahedron index I_Delta (Garoufalidis-Hodgson-Hoffman-Rubinstein 1604.02688 Ex 4.1). I_T(x mu + y lam) = sum_k q^k J_D(2k,k,x) J_D(2k-x+2y,k,-2y), with J_D the symmetric index (eq 4) whose S_3-invariance IS the triality pinned in #3868. Exact integer q-series validated to 11 coefficients: I_T(0) = 1-2q-3q^2+2q^3+8q^4+18q^5+18q^6+14q^7-12q^8-52q^9-106q^10; I_T(lam), I_T(2mu) also match. Corrects the #3868 gluing record (the [1,-8,-9,...] target was a wrong secondary value; the real one is [1,-2,-3,2,8,18,...] and the normalization is eq 4, not an open problem). Audit-only; scope-(a); no fit.
